_comment_distance_threshold: KNOWN CAVEAT (not fixed, flagging for the manuscript): this is a pixel distance, not a physical one. cHL's segmentation dir name states mpp=1.75um/px; IMMUcan's mpp is only ASSUMED at ~1um/px, never confirmed (see HANDOFF). The same 14.28px threshold is therefore ~14.28um on IMMUcan but ~25um on cHL -- not the same physical neighbourhood. This is Stellar's analogue of the tile-size resolution issue Lukas raised for the FMs, even though Stellar has no image tiles. Left as one global default rather than silently guessing a scaled per-dataset value, since IMMUcan's mpp was never verified either.

chl._comment_excluded_markers: Must match the exact filenames under single_channel_dir / lines in markers.txt -- 'anti-H2AX' alone (no suffix) silently fails to match 'anti-H2AX (pS139)' and would NOT be excluded. Fixed 2026-09-23.
